_comment: Maps the 'active within' window of a search to the LastActivityId of the Caterer results URL, and to the text the results page echoes when it applies it (the self-check reads that text). Owner-editable: an invalid file is ignored with a WARN and NO filter is sent (docs/ACTIVITY.md). The ids come from the legacy search probe of 2026-08-05 and are UNVERIFIED-LIVE: the first live ACTIVITY_FILTER log line, or node tools/activity-probe.js, shows what Caterer really does. 3 months and 18 months have no known id and are null on purpose: nothing is guessed, no filter is sent for them. An echo list holds every text that counts as a match; an empty text means the page shows no 'Active within last' part.
